name: baculoviral IAP repeat containing 3

function.text: BIRC3 encodes baculoviral IAP repeat-containing protein 3. Annotated molecular activities include transferase activity and ubiquitin-protein transferase activity. It participates in canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction and non-canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Marginal zone lymphoma; Chronic lymphocytic leukemia / small lymphocytic lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
